title: Origin-aware TTL and epoched evidence handoff for prompts/responses/request telemetry
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Customers need fine-grained TTLs that reflect where requests originate (route, tenant, integration, session) and periodic, cryptographically verifiable evidence bundles for compliance audits. Current per-route TTL model doesn't capture origin tagging (e.g., imported data connectors, human-in-the-loop sessions, third-party tools) and lacks an 'epoched' handoff mechanism for efficient forensic exports across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments.

Proposal: Introduce origin-aware TTLs and an epoched evidence handoff pipeline. Key capabilities: 1) origin tags on every request (route/tenant/integration/session/tool); 2) policy rules that map origin tag sets to TTL and sampling tiers; 3) an "epoch" bundling mechanism that creates time-windowed evidence archives (signed, hashed) for a tenant/route; 4) on-demand ad-hoc evidence export for legal holds; 5) console previews and an API to simulate retention impact before applying policies. The feature must work with Dedicated/Private control planes and support KMS-based signing or customer-managed keys for evidence attestation.
acceptance_criteria: Origin tags added to request metadata and persisted for at least the route evaluation window
Policy UI and JSON DSL to define TTL and sampling rules by origin tag combinations
Epoch bundler produces daily/weekly evidence bundles with manifest (SHA256 hashes) and KMS-signed envelope
Export API can return a zipped evidence bundle with provenance, and an audit trail entry is generated
Retention enforcement removes tokens/artifacts according to effective TTL across hosted/dedicated/private deployments
Console shows simulated storage/cost delta for policy changes and warns about cross-region residency impacts
End-to-end tests for deterministic purge behavior (see dependency ENG-22456) and export integrity checks
Security review completed and customer-managed key (CMK) integration verified
tasks: PM: finalize policy DSL and default presets (full, sampled:0.1, metadata-only)
Design: create console UX for origin tag rules, simulation, and export flows (Figma prototypes)
Eng (Runtime): add origin tag propagation, TTL evaluation hook, and sampling metadata on write paths
Eng (Runtime): implement epoch bundler (configurable window) and manifest generator
Eng (Console): retention policy editor + simulator + export UI
Eng (Infra): integrate KMS signing for bundles and support CMK per-tenant
Security: threat model and key management review
QA: automated tests for purge, export integrity, and cross-region residency enforcement
Docs: user guide for policy DSL, API reference for export, and compliance playbook
SRE: rollout plan and canary strategy for Dedicated and Private customers
decisions: Epoch cadence default: 24 hours (configurable to 1/7/30d), plus on-demand export
Bundle format: TAR.GZ with a JSON manifest containing per-file SHA256 and origin tag summary
Signing: support Redwood-managed KMS by default, allow customer-managed keys (CMK) for enterprise tenants
Sampling tiers: full, deterministic-sample(rate), metadata-only. Deterministic sampling uses request-level stable hash to ensure reproducible exports
Default retention inheritance: route -> tenant -> org, with explicit overrides allowed; UI will highlight effective TTL
